items.exampleEn: Amazingly, the delivery arrived ahead of schedule.
items.exampleZh: 令人驚訝的是，貨比預定時間還早送到。

items.exampleEn: Everyone laughed at the same time.
My science report is a little behind schedule.
items.exampleZh: 我的自然科報告進度有點落後。

items.exampleEn: We found this restaurant by chance.
items.exampleZh: 我們是偶然發現這家餐廳的。

items.exampleEn: Keep paper away from the stove, or it may catch fire.
items.exampleZh: 紙要遠離爐子，不然可能會著火。

items.exampleEn: Dropping your phone can cause damage.
items.exampleZh: 手機摔到可能會造成損壞。

items.sentenceEn: Our flight is behind schedule because of the rain.
items.sentenceZh: 因為下雨，我們的班機誤點了。

items.audioEn: The builders finished the new library ahead of schedule, so it will open in May instead of July.
items.audioZh: 工人提前完成了新圖書館，所以它會在五月開放，而不是七月。
items.questionZh: 新圖書館什麼時候開放？
options: In July, as planned at the start
After the summer holiday is over
Next year, when work is done

items.sentenceEn: I heard about this job by chance.
items.sentenceZh: 我是偶然聽說這份工作的。

items.sentenceEn: The job is hard. At the same time, I really enjoy it.
items.sentenceZh: 這份工作很辛苦，然而我真的很喜歡。

items.stemEn: The old wooden building could easily ____, so smoking is not allowed inside.
items.stemZh: 那棟老木造建築很容易著火，所以室內禁止吸菸。

items.stemEn: I didn't plan to meet her; we met ____ at the market.
items.stemZh: 我沒有計畫要見她，我們是在市場偶然遇到的。

items.passageEn: Work on the new sports hall in our town started last spring. At first, it was behind schedule because heavy rain caused damage to the roads near the site. The builders then worked longer hours, and at the same time, the city sent extra trucks to help. By autumn, the project was ahead of schedule, and the hall opened two weeks early. Many people in town now use it every evening.
items.passageZh: 我們鎮上新體育館的工程去年春天開工。一開始進度落後，因為大雨毀損了工地附近的道路。後來工人延長工作時間，同時市政府也派了更多卡車來幫忙。到了秋天，工程進度超前，體育館提早兩週開放。現在鎮上每天晚上都有很多人去使用。

questions.questionZh: 工程一開始為什麼進度落後？
options: 工人不夠，市政府又不肯幫忙
建築材料的價格突然上漲
設計圖要重新修改好幾次
比原本的計畫晚了一個月
工人加班後的那個冬天

items.promptZh: 露營時，乾樹枝很快就著火了。
referenceEn: While we were camping, the dry branches quickly caught fire.
The dry branches caught fire quickly when we went camping.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「著火」（例如 caught fire 等；caught on fire 也正確）
不用片語但意思正確的說法也算對（例如 started burning、were on fire 等）
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 caught fire、have caught fire 等）
「乾樹枝」可寫，例如 the dry branches、the dry sticks 等

items.promptZh: 我沒辦法同時做兩件事。
referenceEn: I can't do two things at the same time.
I'm not able to do two things at the same time.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「同時」（例如 at the same time 等）
不用片語但意思正確的說法也算對（例如 at once、simultaneously 等）
「沒辦法」可寫，例如 can't、am not able to 等
「兩件事」可寫，例如 two things 等
